title: Asahina Mafuyu — Super Exciting Three-Legged Race?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line: Sigh... That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why are you two sighing while looking at your phones?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line: We were just going through our pics from the Sports Festival and remembering how exciting it was!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line: Look, this one's from the three-legged race you were in, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wow. You took a really good photo.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend B
rows.Line: The girl you were paired up with was a first-year student, wasn't she? What was her name again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend B
rows.Line: Yeah, Otori! She was off the wall!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend B
rows.Line: My friend from the committee said that she came up with a lot of suggestions to make this year's sports day as fun as possible.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line: Really? That's impressive for a first year!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh... I have my student council meeting soon. I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (We're meeting in this classroom I think...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's her. Looks like she's not running around the corridors today.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello, Otori.
You seem to be skipping in high spirits.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ I won a prize with a snack I bought... Hrk!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What pleasant weather we're having today!
Um... Er...

rows.Speaker: 1st Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line: Good morning, Asahina! Could I ask you for some pointers during practice after school?

rows.Speaker: 1st Year Archery Club Member B
rows.Line: H-Hey, I was going to ask her first! If you have time, could you help me with something too?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The girls from my club treat me like some sort of idol, but Otori's different...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You seem to be staring at me...
Is there something on my face?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: S-S-S-Sure there is! Your eyes and nose and mouth...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Heh... Hehe. Well, you're right about that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh... That was a real smile!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By the way, I heard that you came up with a lot of suggestions for improving this year's Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to thank you for that. I enjoyed it a lot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm ready to win!
Let's do this, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Huh? Why did that pop into my mind all of a sudden?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is there really nothing on my face...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, but you're actually smiling now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, I don't know why, but you smile differently sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But during the Sports Festival, your smile was real, and seeing that made me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had a ton of fun in the three-legged race with you too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... My friends are waiting for me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She doesn't really know me, and yet...)
